scope: Replacement of the WORLD04 schematic fern/reed/lycopsid prototypes with grounded arching fronds, tapered trunks, a stepped lycopsid base and distinct per-kind albedo. Placement identity, canonical heights, scales, yaw, fixed L14 window, density tiers, material/shadow/RT path and the no-collision boundary are unchanged. Not planet-wide vegetation, botanical realism, contact or stable performance acceptance.

invariants.identity_and_placement: World-local ScatterId, kind, direction, signed canonical ground height, scale and yaw are unchanged. No vertical offset or root lowering was added; fern fronds begin at local Y=0.
invariants.consumer_contract: One retained (1,L14,6018,11888) WORLD00 window, 4096 candidate visits, 298 surface samples, 222 accepted/retained/submitted plants, 62 ferns / 12 reeds / 148 lycopsids, three draws, zero collision/physics ownership.
invariants.payload: Prototype vertex/index payload grows 15,984 -> 68,256 bytes; the 64-byte-ABI instance buffer remains 14,208 bytes and reported per-frame upload remains 14,784 bytes.
invariants.materials: One existing linearized material per prototype kind; metallic 0, roughness 0.92, double-sided triangle sheets. Albedo sRGB: fern [0.18,0.38,0.10], reed [0.33,0.35,0.11], lycopsid [0.17,0.28,0.10].
invariants.graphics_policy: No settings, resolution, shadow-atlas, environment, topology or RT policy changed by this stage.

fern.construction: 13 arching fronds x 6 ribbon segments, serrated width profile, base Y in 0..0.03 m; grounded clump, no stem

reed.construction: 10 tapered near-vertical blades + 6-blade basal tussock; blades kept within ~10 degrees of vertical for the shared back-face normal flip

lycopsid.construction: 10-sided tapered trunk with stepped root flare and six rings, four near-vertical stub forks below the crown floor, 24 broad arching fronds in three whorls (9/8/7)

geometry.normals: Flat per-triangle normals retained. Winding hints force foliage normals up/outward and trunk normals radially out. A crown frond may tilt inward while rising, but tests require its upper face not to point downward.
geometry.tests: Worldgen tests pin deterministic prototypes, non-degenerate triangles, triangle ceilings 130..180 (fern), 120..170 (reed), 300..380 (tree), local extents, fern min Y in 0..0.02 m, upper-60% normal bounds and crown/trunk winding. The native WORLD00 test re-derives material colors from the producer albedo and asserts the exact 68,256-byte payload.

prototype_checks.implementation_owner: Subagent produced the first arching/grounded geometry and CPU tests. Parent then broadened crown fronds and fern/reeds, added per-kind albedo, fixed the material-color test to derive from the producer, and reran the focused tests before capture.
prototype_checks.worldgen_lib: 3 focused geometry tests passed (1 unrelated ignored CPU cost diagnostic); full worldgen lib previously 232 passed / 1 ignored at the intermediate geometry.
prototype_checks.native_bin: All seven surface_plants CPU tests passed, including exact WORLD00 Low/Medium/High descriptors, disabled/withheld zero work and the exact prototype payload.
prototype_checks.hardware: Lifecycle hardware test passed on Radeon 880M / RADV / Vulkan (2.42 s). Fixed-L14 root oracle passed unchanged: 222 roots hit, signed residual -0.068938668..+0.096391605 m, p50 -0.000603619 m, p95 +0.047214586 m, grid error 0.000053186 m. Geometry does not change canonical roots.
prototype_checks.scoped_gates: rustfmt --check, git diff --check, scoped all-target/all-feature clippy with -D warnings and the architecture check passed before capture.

captures.scenario: WORLD00 target 23.565679258039204N 165.13881581863882E, epoch/step 0, 1280x720, mute/no-HUD, 60 s pre-stream, 30 warmup, 32 measured frames. Overview distance/AGL 1800/800 m; close50 80/50 m; standing2 80/2 m.
captures.disabled_boundary: Off/disabled reports zero plant samples, candidates, prototypes, instances, preparation time and upload, and no plant survey mesh/RT scene.
captures.nondeterminism: Old executable re-captured twice at identical close/standing cameras differs at 5 pixels, maximum channel difference 35/255. Old-vs-new differs at 177,362 pixels (close, max 134/255), 114,027 (standing, max 143/255) and 3,797 (overview, max 101/255), so the blind pairs are materially different.
captures.exact_evidence: capture-commands.json holds all eight commands (including the separately captured old overview) with executable/image/perf/log hashes; capture-inputs.json holds the settings/producer qualification.

blind_review.decoded: A/B assignment was independently shuffled per case. Decoded: arching prototypes preferred at 50 m (A, medium confidence) and 2 m (B, high confidence); overview tie. Preference points 2.5 arching vs 0.5 previous umbrella.
blind_review.reviewer_notes: New form: recognizable frond crowns, tapered trunks, readable ferns, coherent root flare and drooping crown silhouette; thin-frond aliasing/dark speckle remains. Old form: cone-on-pole placeholders, hard faceted shading, laminar cone overlaps and blob shadows.
blind_review.procedure: arena.py stripped identifying PNG metadata and shuffled A/B per case. Reviewer saw only blind-review files, not key/origins/source/logs, and recorded exactly one vote per case before the key was read. One reviewer/one shuffle: not a statistical, ecological or physical acceptance.

cost.performance_boundary: Whole-client GPU timestamp intervals, not isolated foliage cost or game FPS. Runs are serial, single-order and not counterbalanced; view, capture order and thermal state are not separated (the old executable's own 50 m and 2 m medians differ by 9.5 ms). Neither the lower new 50 m median nor the higher overview/2 m medians establish speedup or regression. No memory high-water, frame budget or platform acceptance claimed.

remaining_limitations: Thin fronds alias and can read as dark speckle at 50 m; crown undersides remain dark because the shared material has no foliage transmission.
The ten-sided flat-shaded trunk is visibly faceted at 2 m; fork stubs are near-vertical rather than spreading branches.
No LOD, wind, growth, per-kind shader, collision/physics or per-instance contact correction.
Only one L14 survey window and 222 prototype plants; no planet-wide streaming or production botanical assets.
Actual viewer root-to-resident-triangle residual remains unmeasured; the fixed-patch oracle is not the streamed resident cover.
One blind reviewer and one shuffle; preference is subjective and not physical/ecological/temporal acceptance.
No stable performance acceptance; captures are single-order and uncounterbalanced.
